title: Shortlist
description: An AI agent that reads every new arXiv paper in your fields and tests each change to your interests on real papers before you apply it. Simplified: arXiv only; nothing is kept after the visit.
instructions: Pick a sample researcher, click Not for me on a paper, check the verdict on the assistant's proposal, then open the Agent log.

inference.estimateBasis: Measured on the class gateway: about $0.01 per feed and under $0.01 per assistant message with GPT-6 Luna; up to $0.04 with other models. Portal limits apply.
